purpose: Declare the word->sentence->paragraph->article ladder over fold-neighborhood structure, and constrain it so that realized text restates edges that already exist rather than inventing them.

law.unit: one sentence realizes exactly one relation edge
law.reveal_only: FG2: Unfold(h,tau) reveals relationships represented by B_tau[h,e] != 0; it does not create semantic relationships
law.composition: FG9: Local Fold Validity + Boundary Compatibility => Composable Fold Validity
law.adjacency: KFA C6: composability is pairwise-local: a plan is admissible exactly when every adjacent pair is
law.ordering: horizontal = Delta T (fold-space movement axis); a document is a Delta T ordering, not a phase ordering
law.identity: SC-29: (Fold . Unfold)(h) = h when delta_phi = 0, applied to text as parse(linearize(d)) = d
law.authority: apply-field-not-commit-topology: a document steers semantic computation; it does not mutate the permanent graph
law.phase_note: realization is projection: Pop reads relations, Wo binds their typed ends, Yax orders them by Delta T, Sek scores and selects. Ch'en is not reached because nothing is proven; Xul is not reached because nothing is committed.

mood.law: a control template realizes a command verb (GET, POST, READ, WRITE, PATCH, LIST, INSPECT, RUN, COMPILE, CALL, HEALTH, SEARCH); a declarative template realizes a relation verb
mood.consequence: a document whose sentences come from the control catalog is a runbook, not prose, regardless of how correctly it composes

sources.tokens: data/grammar/gml.khanary.ebnf :: boundary_token, structural delimiter such as ◄/s►

realization.rule: each relation verb in relation_verbs has exactly one declarative template, and each declarative template realizes exactly one relation verb
realization.unrealizable: an edge whose relation verb has no declarative template is a typed declination, never silently dropped and never rendered by a fallback sentence
realization.alias_rule: an alias spelling may be realized as prose, because rendering an edge is not verifying it; such a template must carry via_alias and the spelling must remain RelationCandidate in data/grammar/relation-aliases.contracts.json

forbidden: inventing a relation edge during realization
using an imperative template in a document body
rendering an edge whose subject or object handle is unresolved
rendering a routing frame as prose

phase_contract.Pop: read the relation edges of the revealed neighborhood (gramRead)
phase_contract.Wo: bind subject and object handles to typed values
phase_contract.Yax: order sentences by Delta T into paragraph and section groupings
